659176.rationale: Funeral set for July 4-9, 2026 (Tehran Jul 4-6, Qom Jul 7, Mashhad burial Jul 9). Pezeshkian invited leaders including Russia's, and Russia is expected to send a delegation. Volodin headed Russia's delegation at Raisi's 2024 funeral and at Pezeshkian's inauguration, so he is the protocol default; there is some chance Russia sends someone more senior for a Supreme Leader.
659176.next_info: Kremlin/Peskov or TASS statement on the delegation, likely Jun 29-Jul 3; also check Duma and Federation Council announcements.

339902.rationale: The US-Iran MOU of June 18 opened a 60-day negotiation window (to about Aug 17), and the Senate passed a war powers resolution. Kataib Hezbollah and Nujaba refuse to disarm and threaten US bases. The Houthis rejoined the fighting on June 8 by attacking ships. US strikes in the Jul 22-29 window happen only if the ceasefire frays.
339902.next_info: Iraqi militia attacks on US forces, Houthi shipping attacks, and the state of US-Iran talks in mid/late July; CENTCOM statements.

107175.rationale: No specific proposal found as of Jun 24. The Houthis renewed Red Sea/Gulf of Aden attacks on Jun 8-9 and Saudi exports depend on Yanbu, so the leading candidates are Red Sea littoral powers (Saudi Arabia, Egypt) or Western naval leaders. Israel is courting Somaliland for Red Sea influence.
107175.next_info: Houthi attack tempo in July; any Saudi, Egyptian, Red Sea Council, or US/UK announcement Jul 1-Aug 1.

817209.rationale: The Islamabad MOU (Art. 5) makes Iran do the mine clearing within 30 days and has it coordinate Hormuz administration with Oman. Iran and Oman formed a joint working group on Jun 23 and issue joint statements. Iran rejects foreign naval minesweeping, including the UK-France 40-nation mission. Japan is weighing a demining role.
817209.next_info: Iran-Oman working group outputs; Iran's 30-day mine-clearing deadline (~Jul 18); any Iran-China or Iran-Japan statements; deadline Aug 26.

246629.rationale: Bahrain's parliament unanimously passed an urgent proposal for a full trade boycott of Iran in April 2026 and sent it to the cabinet. Iran struck Bahrain and Kuwait again in June. The UAE took the most missiles but depends on Dubai-Iran trade.
246629.next_info: Bahrain cabinet decisions (weekly meetings); GCC posture if US-Iran talks fail around Aug 17-21.

916964.rationale: Low-information question. Treasury's 'Economic Fury' campaign repeatedly targets Iran-backed Iraqi militias (KH, KSS, Nujaba, AAH), and the Houthis rejoined the war in June. OFAC often issues 'designation updates' that amend existing SDN entries.
916964.next_info: OFAC recent actions and State Dept FTO amendments in August 2026; Federal Register notices.

790870.rationale: Essentially unpredictable. The oil-sanctions waiver runs to about Aug 21, and Treasury has threatened secondary sanctions on foreign banks tied to Chinese teapot refineries. The likely targets are Iraqi or Chinese banks, so probability is spread thinly.
790870.next_info: Outcome of the US-Iran 60-day talks (~Aug 17) and waiver expiry (Aug 21); OFAC actions Aug 31-Sep 6.

56802.rationale: Pakistan has a 2025 mutual defense pact with Saudi Arabia, mediated the US-Iran Islamabad MOU, and hosted Pezeshkian in June. China has precedent (it pressed Iran on the Houthis in 2024) and brokered the 2023 Saudi-Iran deal. Qatar co-mediated.
56802.next_info: Reuters exclusives Aug 1-Sep 17; Houthi attacks on Saudi targets or Red Sea shipping.

508136.rationale: In January 2026 Saudi forces retook Mayun from UAE-aligned forces. Since then the Saudi-Yemeni command has controlled access (it turned back a UAE aircraft in April), and the Red Sea Coast Guard sector (NRF naval units under Tareq Saleh) is based there. The government side almost surely retains control; how AP/Al Jazeera labels it is the main uncertainty.
508136.next_info: AP/Al Jazeera reporting in early Sept 2026 on Bab al-Mandeb; any Houthi move on the island.

461239.rationale: Lincoln has been deployed since late 2025 (South China Sea in Jan, CENTCOM since late Jan) and was enforcing the blockade from the Arabian Sea. A port call after Aug 1 is either a liberty stop in the region (Duqm/Salalah in Oman most likely; ports inside the Gulf are risky) or a stop on the transit home (Singapore, Guam/Hawaii).
461239.next_info: Navy/CENTCOM releases on Lincoln's location; relief by other carriers (Bush arrived ~June); AP reporting in August.

834692.rationale: No Xi Middle East trip had been announced by Jun 24, and China hosts the 2nd China-Arab States Summit in 2026, which reduces his need to travel. If he does travel, Saudi Arabia, Egypt (70th anniversary of ties) or the UAE are the likeliest hosts.
834692.next_info: Chinese MFA announcements of Xi state visits; China-Arab summit date.

112235.rationale: As of June 2026 only the US recognizes Israeli sovereignty over the Golan; the UK and EU reaffirm it is occupied Syrian territory. Milei calls himself 'the most Zionist president' and backed the Iran war, so Argentina is the top candidate if anyone recognizes.
112235.next_info: Any Milei/Netanyahu announcements; Colombia's de la Espriella inauguration Aug 7; Israeli lobbying.

299105.rationale: The US naval blockade of Iranian ports (April to mid-June) and the Hormuz closure crushed oil exports and output in spring 1405 (Mar 21-Jun 20). SCI's 1404 data had oil as the only growing sector (+1.8%), with agriculture -2.9%, industry -1.5% and services +0.3%. Industry was also hit by strikes.
299105.next_info: SCI quarterly national accounts for spring 1405, likely Aug-Sep 2026 (IRNA, Financial Tribune).
